newsitem.title: USA: Sun Micro to pay $51 mln to California for R&D campus.
newsitem.headline: Sun Micro to pay $51 mln to California for R&D campus.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc. has agreed pay California $51 million for surplus state land for use as a new research and development campus, state officials said on Monday.
California state officials said the sale would be completed in September after entitlements for the property have been obtained from the city of Santa Clara.
Sun would not disclose the purchase price, but state officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said Sun would buy the 82.5 acres in Santa Clara for roughly $51 million.
Sun's proposed research and development campus will include more than 1 million square feet of office space and could accommodate up to 3,600 workers.
"This is a win-win for taxpayers and for Sun," Gov. Pete Wilson, a Republican, said in a statement. "The state is selling surplus land while helping create jobs."
Based in Mountain View, Calif., Sun is a leading provider of hardware, software and services for computer networks.
